Title: Azure Storage Blob inventory public preview is now available in all public regions

Body.Content:
Azure blob storage inventory provides you the ability to understand the total number of objects, their size, tier, and other information to gain insight into your object storage estate. Inventory can be used with Azure Synapse to calculate summaries by container.

We have expanded preview to all public regions for blob inventory.

Learn more about blob inventory. 

To use with Azure Synapse, read the how to guide.
